primaryChecks.text: The lot for the tribe of the children of Judah according to their families was to the border of Edom, even to the wilderness of Zin southward, at the uttermost part of the south.
contextRefs: JOS 15:2 — Their south border was from the uttermost part of the Salt Sea, from the bay that looks southward;

primaryChecks.text: The farthest cities of the tribe of the children of Judah toward the border of Edom in the South were Kabzeel, Eder, Jagur,
contextRefs: JOS 15:20 — This is the inheritance of the tribe of the children of Judah according to their families.
